body:
you, deep in a tag page, trying to remember what she wore and when. same. that's honestly why we built the runway thread 👗

it puts her looks in order, era by era, so you get to watch the closet change instead of piecing it together from a pile of photos.

my favourite place to start is the speak now world tour, 2011. it went completely theatrical: flowing gowns, castles, and every song with its own staged set piece, right down to the ballroom backdrop for "enchanted."

this is her on that tour, mid "love story," and i am so in love with this era's whole fairy tale thing.

tap runway on longlivets.com → https://longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread

critique.rationale: Tells the Runway thread's reason for existing in a fan's voice and anchors it in the sourced Speak Now World Tour staging, gowns and the Enchanted ballroom set. The photo shows Taylor on that very tour, mid Love Story.

why: IG sibling of the Runway origin-story hero. Single photo, no screenshot slide: I could not verify a rich Runway-lens screenshot this run, and a flat one is banned. The caption survives the Facebook cross-post (no swipe line).
